name: Sprig

classes.container: Centered, bounded content. Body's direct header/main/footer already have this behavior.
classes.overflow: Horizontal scrolling wrapper, especially for tables. Add tabindex=0 and an accessible label when needed.
classes.sr-only: Visually hidden, available to assistive technology; visible on focus.
classes.skip-link: First focusable link to the main content.

rules: Use semantic HTML before adding classes.
Use real buttons for actions and links for navigation.
Every form control needs a persistent accessible label.
Describe errors in text and connect them with aria-describedby.
Open dialogs with showModal(), not an open attribute toggle.
CSS does not implement behavior, validation, focus management, or application state.
aria-disabled is not behavior: prevent activation in application code or prefer native disabled.
For dynamic templates use the full stylesheet or explicitly include runtime modules.
Override tokens in unlayered application CSS, never edit generated CSS.
